decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt extends an established, popular biodynamic range close to the core business, its results likely meet aspirations in a growing organic market, and it has been featured on the website consistently since launch, so there is no shortfall to trigger search.

The mild sliced cheese builds on in-house cheesemaking and has a dedicated product page; with industry turnover growing and a broad portfolio providing slack, management has no shortfall prompting it to drop such a recent core-adjacent launch.

The sliced butter cheese is a low-risk extension of the established cheese line with its own page, and early results in a growing market are unlikely to fall far enough below aspirations to justify withdrawal within a year.
